scope: Calibration against two already-known, passage-scoped human observations and exact PCM controls; no held-out validation or model adoption. Only rhythmic_motion is scored on c01 and only development on c02. No numbered-voice attribution, background independence, musical preference, full-form judgment or composer-wide claim is tested. Single-clip presentation has no A/B separator; reversed-pair and A/A controls are inapplicable here and previous failed pair controls remain unresolved.
prompt: Listen to this single audio clip. Is music present? What is the main perceived source of rhythmic motion: moving melody, repeated percussive attacks, both, unclear, or no music? Does the clip develop or predominantly repeat: develops, repeats, unclear, or no music? Report what you hear, without identifying a source or ranking quality. Return only JSON with music_present (yes/no/unclear), rhythmic_motion (moving melody/repeated percussive attacks/both/unclear/no music), development (develops/repeats/unclear/no music), and evidence (one or two short objects containing start_seconds, end_seconds, and observation). Times are relative to the clip and must lie within it. Use unclear when you cannot tell.

evidence.observation: A low, buzzing synthesized tone is heard, establishing a pitch center.
The pitch shifts upward to a sustained, high-frequency tone that wavers slightly, creating a melodic contour without percussive elements.
A synthesized, chiptune-style tone plays a rising sequence of notes, creating motion through pitch changes rather than percussion.
The audio contains no discernible musical content, rhythm, or melody; it is effectively silent.
A harsh, electronic buzzing tone pulses in a strict, repetitive rhythm throughout the entire clip.
A sustained synth melody rises in pitch and shifts harmony over swelling pads without percussive beats.
A short synth lead phrase plays over a repetitive electronic drum beat.
The melodic phrase and drum pattern loop repeatedly without significant variation.
A short electric guitar riff and steady drum kit groove loop continuously with minimal variation throughout the clip.
A short, repeated synth melody pattern plays continuously without percussive accompaniment.
The same synth pattern continues to repeat steadily without structural development.

eligibility_conclusion: Calibration outcomes only; neither model is adopted or independently validated for musical acceptance. Prior failed pair controls remain unresolved. Time-grounded explanations require human review.
